input: Sell old furniture on a local marketplace app

gold.taskTitle: Sell Old Furniture on a Local Marketplace App
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to list and sell their old furniture using a local marketplace app.

questions.title: Which specific app are you planning to use?
questions.description: Identify the marketplace platform the user intends to sell on, such as Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp, or another local app.

questions.title: How many furniture pieces are you selling?
questions.description: Determine the total number of items the user needs to list so the plan can be scoped appropriately.

questions.title: What condition are the furniture pieces in?
questions.description: Understand whether the items are like-new, gently used, or worn, as this affects pricing and how listings are written.

questions.title: Do you already know the prices you want?
questions.description: Find out if the user has prices in mind or needs help researching fair market values for each item.

questions.title: Do you have good photos of the furniture ready?
questions.description: Determine whether the user still needs to take photos or already has images prepared for the listings.

questions.title: Will buyers pick up, or do you offer delivery?
questions.description: Clarify the logistics preference so pickup or delivery details can be included in the listing plan.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which you need it sold?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure, such as a move or renovation date, that would affect pricing urgency and follow-up strategy.
